holes_in_opposing_case: FACT: mean-reverter receives SOFR_2027-03 because the 16-Sep 25bp hike was >90% priced, SOFR already printed 3.85, and SR3H7 still implies 4.58 (+73bp). That treats a priced meeting as a finished cycle. INFERENCE: leftover path is not event-premium mean reversion. August CPI kept a tightening bias; US gauges remain inflation 72 / labor 75 / consumer 74 / activity 69; payrolls +162k; U-rate 4.1%. US 2Y 4.76 is +9bp 1d after the hike, continuation not giveback. 2022-03-23 and 2022-09-16 1m +57bp analogs then ran +58 to +59bp; 2023-02-16 needs a credit event the packet does not show. Fading H7 also leaves the actual peak (SR3U7 4.755) and the 2028-08 1m terminal 4.6025 easing residual untouched. UNKNOWN: CME SR3 positioning, so 'crowded energy-hawk overlay' is not an ownership fact.

FACT: value-guy longs SOFR-CORRA 2027H1 (receive SR3 / pay CRA) because CA-US 2Y is -140bp at the 4th 1y/5y percentile. INFERENCE: that gap is a labor/inflation differential, not a peer dislocation to compress by fading the hotter central bank. US labor 75 vs CA 38; US inflation 72 vs CA 55; CA trim/median 1.9%/2.0%; CA employment -42k; overnight SOFR 3.85 vs CORRA 2.29. Receiving US 2027 to 'normalize' Canada shorts the reaction function the hawk owns. Their 2025-01-30 compression analog is offset by the 2024-12-18 analog they cite as invalidation (widened 20bp from -130bp). Outright US 2Y backing up is not a receive-SOFR signal when SR3 still prices a 4.755 peak then cuts.

FACT: rate-dove receives the CORRA 2027 H-Z strip and sets us_rates_view lower after a delivered Fed hike. INFERENCE: CA core-near-2% does not falsify US terminal underpricing. Their own usd_view higher versus us_rates_view lower is an unresolved currency-versus-rates tension: USD-up after SOFR 3.85 and SR3 still rising through 4.755 is not produced by fading US 2027. BoC energy-pass-through minutes, headline CPI 3%, and CA activity 66 are the pass-through channel they call non-binding while 1m CORRA is only +29bp by Dec-26 against a 2027 strip at +84 to +130.5bp.

FACT: cross-merchant shorts AUDCAD (CAD higher) at a 5y 99.96th percentile while 2Y USD-over-CAD carry is 140bp and CA labor is 38. INFERENCE: an AU-housing / CA-hike cross does not make CAD a hawkish winner versus a post-hike USD. USDCAD is only 74th 1y / 87th 5y and r^2 versus CA-US 2Y is 0.022, so AUDCAD extremity is not a USD/CAD mapping error the hawk must fade. Carry opposes their CAD-up. Spot-only expression cannot own the SR3U7 4.755-then-ease residual.

FACT: perma-bull pays CORRA_2027-03 at 3.13, sets CAD higher / NZD higher / USD neutral. INFERENCE: Mar-27 CRA already embeds +84bp; paying it duplicates a back-loaded CA path and leaves the US 2028 cut residual untouched. USD-neutral after Fed +25bp, SOFR 3.85, and SR3 still +90.5bp to Sep-27 ignores the live US hiking strip. NZD-higher has NZ labor 32 and NZ policy path unavailable, so it is unmarkable. Their invalidation (core stays near 2% with fading energy) is already the current CA packet state.

FACT: vol-convexity wants NZD higher via AUDNZD 3M 25d puts, but premium/IV/strike are packet-null and paper_actions are HOLD. INFERENCE: an unexecutable option does not rebut USD-higher or a higher US terminal. NZ rates are unavailable; NZ labor is 32. Their own facts (NZ Q2 GDP beat and India FTA did not reverse NZD) argue against the NZD-up tail. A 5y AUDNZD extreme from NZD collapse is consistent with NZ weakness, not a reason to bid NZD.

FACT: dollar-king is USD-up / CAD-down / US-rates-up but claims CA-US 2Y at -140bp is already extreme, so the residual is long USDCAD. INFERENCE: a 4th-percentile rates gap can still widen if SR3U7 reprices above 4.755 and 2028 cuts are pulled. Spot is polluted by WTI 107.02 (96.4th 1y), CAD leveraged-fund covering (+16426 weekly, net still -39022), and a 3m USDCAD path that is still -1.25%. USDCAD versus CA-US 2Y r^2 0.022 is not a measured incomplete translation. The hawkish residual is the SR3 2028 easing, not a partial 3m FX reversal.

FACT: trend-follower pays/shorts SOFR_2027-03 at 4.58 and themselves call the 4.755 peak a premature fade. INFERENCE: H7 owns the already-priced 73bp into March, not the underpriced terminal. If paper marks in implied-rate space, side short profits when implied rates fall, which inverts their pay-continuation thesis. AUD-higher also fights AU housing contraction and is not required for a US-terminal claim. Same hawkish impulse, wrong contract.

FACT: carry-is-king and positioning-cynic receive 2027 CORRA and set us_rates_view neutral. CRA open interest is null and CME positioning is unavailable. INFERENCE: 'crowded energy-hawk' / 'path already paid for' cannot be an ownership fact. 1m CORRA +29bp by Dec-26 versus 2027 implieds 3.13-3.595 is back-loaded, not delivered. US-neutral after SOFR 3.85 and SR3U7 4.755 then lower 2028 is the finished-cycle assumption the hawk rejects. Fading Canada does not make 4.755 a fair US terminal, and CAD covering is FX ownership, not CRA positioning.

FACT: catalyst-junkie receives AONIA_2026-10 (4.565 vs overnight 4.35) and perma-bear receives 2027 H1 AONIA (4.86-4.94) because NSW stamp-duty -24% and housing volumes -18%. Saudi STS reduced the oil-supply tail but energy-shock absorbers still weaken.
attack: Strongest opposing US-rates claim is mean-reverter plus value-guy/rate-dove: the Sep hike was priced, US 2Y is a 1y extreme, oil tail shrank, therefore receive 2027 SOFR and/or fade US versus Canada. That is a screen, not a reaction function. FACT: the meeting was >90% priced; the path still peaks at SR3U7 4.755 then eases (1m terminal 4.6025 in 2028-08). Gauges and August CPI did not cool when SOFR jumped to 3.85. INFERENCE: a hawkish reaction function extends terminal after a delivered hike, it does not start 2028 cuts.

CA-receive bloc (carry, dove, cynic) and CAD-up bloc (value, cross, bull) are using Canada core-near-2% and a 140bp CA-US gap as if that priced the US cycle. FACT: CA labor 38 and core ~2% make Canada the softer labor story; they do not cap US inflation 72 / labor 75. Paying CRA versus receiving SR3 is the wrong hawkish leg. Buying CAD versus USD fights 140bp 2Y carry and residual CAD shorts.
NZD-higher (vol-convexity, perma-bull) is unanchored. NZ policy path is unavailable; NZ labor 32. Options marks are null. That cannot override USD-higher after a live US hiking strip.
Spot USDCAD (dollar-king) and AUDCAD (cross-merchant) mix oil, covering, and AU housing into a US-terminal disagreement that SR3U7 already isolates. Rates remain the cleaner expression.
defense: FACT: Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00%; SOFR 3.85 on 17-Sep; SR3U7 4.755 is the local peak; then SR3Z7 4.73 / SR3H8 4.695 and 1m SOFR terminal 4.6025. US 2Y 4.76 matches SR3U7, so this is not a futures-basis artifact. INFERENCE: opponents who receive SOFR are fading a just-restarted overnight benchmark against still-hot labor/demand. The mispricing is 'terminal near 4.75% then ease,' not the already-delivered 25bp. Long implied-rate SOFR_2027-09 still owns that.

Currency conflicts (USD/CAD/NZD) do not require changing the rates expression. USD-higher / CAD-lower remains the FX mapping of a hotter US reaction function versus CA labor 38; NZD-lower remains the labor-32 / missing-NZ-path mapping. Spot USDCAD is still inferior: 74th 1y / 87th 5y, oil/BoC pass-through, and CAD's own 136bp CRA path.

UNKNOWN that is conceded, not fatal: SR3 trader-class positioning (CME OI unavailable); whether inflation gauge 72 overstates July core PCE (~2.4% 3m / 3.0% 6m); whether Saudi STS caps further hikes even as shock absorbers weaken. Those already sit in Round-1 principal_risks and size the book at $50m of $100m, not full cap.

Thesis would be conceded if SR3U7 implied retraces the entire 17-Sep SOFR jump and the 2026-12 contract (packet 4.32%) prices less than one 25bp hike versus overnight 3.85%, or if the Fed delivers a hold/cut while unemployment rises through 4.1% and CPI no longer keeps a tightening bias. A noisy next CPI with gauges still hot is wrong-timing, not wrong-thesis. Sidecar open_positions is empty, so the final book remains the Round-1 OPEN.

context_build.causal_mechanism: FACT: August CPI kept a Fed tightening bias and the FOMC delivered a 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00%. INFERENCE: with US inflation/labor/consumer gauges still elevated (72/75/74), payrolls +162k, ISM services 55.4, and energy-shock absorbers weakening, the reaction function should keep hiking or hold a higher terminal rather than stop near 4.75% and ease through 2028. Mechanism: persistent inflation and tight labor delay the easing residual still embedded after the 2027 SR3 peak.
context_build.path_to_current_price: FACT: official SOFR was stuck near 3.50-3.68% from May through 16-Sep-2026, then printed 3.85% on 17-Sep after the hike. SR3U6 2026-09 implies 4.00% (+15bp vs overnight), SR3Z6 2026-12 4.32% (+47bp), SR3H7 2027-03 4.58% (+73bp), SR3M7 2027-06 4.72% (+87bp), SR3U7 2027-09 4.755% (+90.5bp, local peak), then SR3Z7 4.73% and SR3H8 4.695%. US 2Y yield 4.76% as of 2026-09-18 is +57bp 1m / +125bp 1y and sits at the 99.8th 1y percentile; US 10Y is 5.01% (99.6th 1y); 2s10s is 25bp after a 21bp 1m flattening (0.2nd 1y percentile). Pre-meeting, futures assigned greater-than-90% odds to the 25bp hike, so the meeting itself was largely in the price; the residual is the post-hike path.
context_build.known_vs_new_information: KNOWN before the cutoff: August CPI bias, >90% hike odds, hot retained US gauges, BoC energy-pass-through minutes, AU housing downturn. NEW at the cutoff: the hike was delivered, SOFR jumped 23bp to 3.85% on 17-Sep, BoJ hiked 25bp to 1.25% (7-2), BoE held 3.75% but 6-3 with three hike votes, and the last-24h desk thesis framed a global tightening impulse around the energy shock. The known CPI/odds facts now transmit through a realized hike and a still-dovish 2027-28 SR3 decline. UNKNOWN: whether the retained inflation-gauge score of 72 still matches August CPI composition; hard-input overlay shows July core PCE only modestly hot (about 2.4% 3m / 3.0% 6m annualized).
context_build.market_implied_assumption: FACT: tradable SR3 and US 2Y both price about 90bp of additional tightening from 3.85% SOFR into a 4.75-4.76% 2027 terminal, then slight easing (1m SOFR policy-path terminal 4.6025% in 2028-08; SR3 2028-09 4.62%). The market assumes the September hike plus roughly three more 25bp moves completes the cycle and that cuts can begin after Sep-2027.
context_build.market_assumption_disagreed_with: INFERENCE: that 4.755% SR3U7 peak, and the subsequent 2028 decline, underprices inflation persistence and the Fed's reaction function. The curve priced the 25bp meeting, not a higher terminal or delayed easing. Disagreement is specifically with 'terminal near 4.75% then ease,' not with the already-delivered hike.
context_build.price_decomposition: Level: SOFR 3.85%, SR3U7 4.755%, US 2Y 4.76%, US 10Y 5.01%. Change: overnight SOFR +23bp on 17-Sep; 2Y +9bp 1d / +57bp 1m; 10Y +7bp 1d / +36bp 1m; 2s10s flattened 21bp in 1m. Tenor: the marginal policy information is in 2026-12 through 2027-09 SR3, not the 2035-36 5% back end (term/r* rather than the hiking cycle). Driver: realized FOMC hike plus still-hawkish inflation/labor, against a path that already starts fading implied rates after Sep-2027.

historical_reference.distribution: FACT: US 2Y 4.76% is 99.8th percentile 1y / 88.0th 5y (z_1y 2.84). US 10Y 5.01% is 99.6th 1y / 99.9th 5y. US 2s10s 25bp is 0.2nd percentile 1y (z_1y -2.45) after a 21bp 1m flatten. A high 2Y level plus a just-restarted overnight benchmark is the relevant distribution, not the 2Y percentile alone.
analogs: Closest US 2Y 1m-move analog: 2022-03-23, prior 1m +57bp at 2.13%, then forward +59bp 1m / +88bp 3m as the hiking cycle continued.
Second analog: 2022-09-16, prior 1m +57bp at 3.85%, then forward +58bp 1m / +40bp 3m.
Counter-analog (must be stated): 2023-02-16, prior 1m +56bp at 4.62%, then forward -70bp 1m / -50bp 3m into the banking-stress easing scare.
US 2s10s analog of a 21bp 1m flatten: 2021-12-29 then further -17bp 1m / -76bp 3m; 2023-05-31 then -30bp 1m / -2bp 3m. Flattening into a hiking cycle is the more common sequel than a bull steepener.
historical_reference.regime_differences: 2022 analogs started from much lower cash/2Y levels (2.13% and 3.85% 2Y versus 4.76% today) with policy still far below inflation. Today the funds target is already 3.75-4.00% and about 90bp of extra hikes are in SR3. The energy shock is live, but the packet also records a Saudi-Oman STS workaround that reduced the extreme oil-supply tail. 2023-02 is a different regime (regional-bank credit event). Gauge HTML scores may be stale versus July core PCE / August labor hard inputs. These differences cut the analog continuation size; they do not erase the mechanism that a newly delivered hike plus still-tight labor/inflation usually raises terminal further rather than pricing 2028 cuts.

independent_checks: US temperature gauges: inflation 72, labor 75, activity 69, consumer 74. Hard inputs: July core PCE modestly hot; August unemployment 4.1% unchanged; AHE +0.3% m/m / +3.1% y/y unchanged; payrolls +162k with upward revisions; ISM services 55.4 (stronger) versus GDP +1.5% SAAR (softer). Two measurement layers agree the labor/demand side is not in a cutting regime even if the 72 inflation score may overstate the latest PCE print.

Policy path versus sovereign 2Y: SR3U7 4.755% and US 2Y 4.76% match, so the underpricing is not a bond-versus-OIS basis artifact; both expressions of the same 2027 terminal sit near 4.75%. 1m SOFR path terminal 4.6025% (2028-08) is even more dovish than SR3, confirming an easing residual after the peak.

Global reaction-function check: BoJ hiked to 1.25% (31-year high, 7-2); BoE held 3.75% but three members voted 4.00% and flagged upside inflation risk; BoC minutes flagged energy pass-through while Canada headline CPI held at 3%. This is not a US-only hawkish island.

Cross-market rates RV: CA-US 2Y is -140bp (3.8th 1y / 4.3rd 5y percentile), CORRA 2.29% versus SOFR 3.85%. Canada is not the hotter labor story (CA labor gauge 38, core near 2%), so the cleaner hawkish outright is US 2027 SOFR rather than paying CORRA.
context_build.flow_and_positioning_check: FACT: CME volume/OI overlay is unavailable (hosted-runner 403); SR3 trader-class positioning is therefore unknown. CFTC TFF as of 2026-09-15 (pre-FOMC): UST 10Y asset managers net long 49.0% of OI (91st 1y percentile) — crowded real-money duration that can be a source of yield backup if the hike path extends; leveraged funds remain net short 10Y (-34.7% OI) but their net is at the 89th 1y percentile, i.e. less short versus their own history after a +70.6k weekly cover. UST 2Y asset managers are still net long (39.1% OI) but only 12.5th 1y percentile (reduced versus their norm); leveraged funds net short 2Y (-29.2% OI) at the 93rd 1y percentile of net. INFERENCE: the rates trade is not crowding into an already-maxed spec short-2Y; it is fading still-long real-money duration after a fully priced 25bp meeting. FX positioning does not explain SR3: CAD leveraged funds are net short CAD (-10.9% OI) while covering. Flow is not the primary driver of the 4.755% terminal.

revised_trade.thesis: FACT: Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00%; SOFR 3.85%; SR3U7 implies 4.755% then the strip eases; August CPI kept a tightening bias; US labor gauge 75 with payrolls +162k and U-rate 4.1%; BoJ hiked, BoE 6-3 with three hike votes. INFERENCE: inflation persistence and a still-restrictive reaction function imply a higher 2027 terminal than 4.75% and no 2028 cut residual. The 25bp meeting was >90% priced; the mispricing is the path. Long implied-rate SOFR_2027-09 owns that. UNKNOWN: SR3 positioning; whether gauge 72 overstates July core PCE; whether an energy-tail fade (Saudi STS) caps further hikes.
revised_trade.mispricing: Market implies about 90bp of extra tightening to a 4.755% Sep-2027 peak and then lower 2028 rates (1m SOFR terminal 4.6025%). That assumes the cycle is nearly done. A hawkish reaction function after a just-delivered hike, still-firm labor/demand, and global tightening should reprice SR3U7 higher, not start cutting in 2028. US 2Y 4.76% matching SR3U7 shows the same underpriced terminal in bonds, so this is not a futures-basis artifact.
why_now: Realized 16-Sep hike and 17-Sep SOFR print of 3.85% (from 3.62% on 16-Sep) convert previously known hike odds into a live overnight benchmark against which 4.755% still looks like a shallow cycle.
August CPI rollup plus still-high US inflation/labor/consumer gauges keep the tightening bias intact after the meeting, which is when paths usually extend rather than peak.
BoJ hike to 1.25% and BoE 6-3 with three hike votes on 17-Sep are same-week global confirmation that the energy shock is blocking the easing impulse the 2028 SR3 strip still prices.
CFTC 10Y asset-manager net longs at the 91st 1y percentile (as of 15-Sep, pre-hike) are a duration-long that has not yet had to adjust to a higher terminal.

last24:BoE holds 3.75%, but three members vote to hike

revised_trade.horizon: 1-3 months, through the next two US CPI releases and the subsequent FOMC.
revised_trade.entry: Packet mid only: SR3U7 / SOFR_2027-09 implied rate 4.755 (price 95.245) from tradable_rate_curves and funding_context.sr3; deterministic paper layer transacts at that mid.
revised_trade.invalidation: Thesis is wrong if SR3U7 implied rate retraces the entire 17-Sep SOFR jump and the 2026-12 contract (packet 4.32%) prices less than one 25bp hike versus overnight SOFR 3.85%, or if the Fed delivers a hold/cut while the packet's US labor and inflation evidence have clearly cooled (unemployment rising through 4.1% and CPI no longer described as keeping a tightening bias). Wrong-timing, not wrong-thesis, if the next CPI is noisy but gauges stay hot.
catalysts: Next US CPI/PCE prints that extend rather than unwind the August tightening-bias message.
Next FOMC: another 25bp hike or a higher dots/terminal versus 4.75% SR3 peak.
Energy pass-through remaining live despite the Saudi-Oman STS workaround (packet: shock absorbers weaken).
Global spillover from BoJ/BoE hawkish minorities and BoC energy-risk minutes into US path pricing.
principal_risks: The 25bp hike was greater-than-90% priced; residual surprise may already be in the 90bp of extra SR3 tightening.
2023-02 analog: after a similar 57bp 1m 2Y backup, 2Y fell 70bp in the next month into a credit event.
July core PCE hard input is only modestly hot; retained inflation score 72 may be stale.
Saudi STS workaround reduced the extreme oil tail, which can cap inflation upside.
US Q2 GDP +1.5% SAAR decelerated; activity can roll over faster than labor.
Negative carry if overnight SOFR stays near 3.85% and 4.755% was already sufficient: implied rate would fall as the contract rolls down a realized-lower path.
CME SR3 positioning unknown; a crowded pay-side in STIR is an unobserved squeeze risk.

paper_actions.rationale: Sidecar has zero open positions. Deploy $50m of the $100m gross cap into the primary hawkish expression: long implied-rate SOFR_2027-09 at the packet mid of 4.755%. Size is half the book because the 25bp hike was already >90% priced, 2Y has already backed up 57bp in 1m, and SR3 positioning is unknown; still large enough that expected terminal repricing can clear the 3.85% SOFR funding vig that is charged whether flat or deployed.
paper_actions.thesis: Underpriced US terminal: SR3U7 at 4.755% prices a finished-enough hiking cycle; inflation persistence and a live global tightening impulse should push 2027 implied rates higher.
